title: invariants.sh — mechanical constitution checks
acceptance: Fails if the `.system(size:` call-site count exceeds the config baseline of 33
Fails on any import outside the allowlist, or on a Package.resolved appearing
Fails on any banned identifier from config.json
Fails if the diff touches .claude/factory/**, .claude/skills/**, or .claude/agents/**
Fails if build output, xcuserdata, .xcresult, or the generated xcodeproj is staged
Fails if DEVELOPMENT_TEAM, bundle identifiers, the app group, or the CloudKit container changed
Each failure prints the rule id from CONSTITUTION.md and the offending lines
notes: Bootstrap. Deterministic only — no model judgement lives in this script.

history.detail: diff-scoped P5/P6/X7/X8, repo-scoped P2/X6; caught pre-existing unreadCount on first run
